findings.reason: the refusal is fail-closed, its done-when pins both the refusal and the promote-through case, and no run that legitimately promotes without a report is cited, so the implementation a builder writes is unaffected; only a clarifying sentence is owed.
findings.text: §15's refusal keys on the composed directory holding no `report.md`; because `crew review-plan` always composes that directory (the misdelivered run's own composed dir still holds `dispatch.json`, `plan-review.json`, `brief.md` and `plan.html`), the "composed directory cannot be found" branch is nearly dead and a plan-review run that never delivered any report is refused promotion although §15's Why reasons only about a report written to the wrong place

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/crew/promotion.py`, `delivered_reports` (plan_review.py:1919), the composed directory `r-20261008T005220444149-…`, the sibling `r-20261008T005221071177-…`, its `dispatch.json`, its `report.md` and `prompt.txt` all resolve, and the census of 3 reproduces.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §15's done-when names a declared negative control ("The first case fails when the refusal is removed") and both arms (refusal naming both directories; report in place promotes as §13 does) are assertable.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the cited evidence sits on the durable host tree (`~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/nova/plan-review/converged-forward-solve/` and the run directory), not a scratchpad, and each is named concretely enough to reopen.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §15 carries no plan label, ticket number, version tag or changelog prose into symbols or comments; its run ids are evidence anchors.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §15 refuses on "the report directory whose `dispatch.json` names it holds no `report.md`", but composition always creates that directory, so the declared escape ("a plan-review run whose composed directory cannot be found") is effectively unreachable and the refusal in practice also catches a plan-review run that delivered a report nowhere at all.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §15 is declared "One node, in `reckon/crew/promotion.py`" with a single deliverable (refuse a misdelivered plan-review promotion).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §15 carries no depends-on/gates and its one writer path (`promotion.py`) was released by §13 (landed); followup f-erkc-016 dispatches it and nothing it needs is missing.
